class.name: NNBTRandomSelector
class.brief_description: Executes its child nodes in a random order until one of them succeeds (returning [code]1[/code]) or all of them fail (returning [code]-1[/code]).
class.description: This node type is used to create fallbacks. The [NNBTRandomSelector] node executes its child nodes in a random order until one of them succeeds (returning [code]1[/code]) or all of them fail (returning [code]-1[/code]). If a child returns running (0) the selector will return running to its parent. The random order is chosen when a run starts and stays fixed until the run ends, so a child added during a run joins the next run. A child removed during a run drops out of the current run and is never ticked again, even if it was the running child; the selector then continues with the next surviving child.
